title: Tools of Destruction USA v02.00 executable and save research map

binary.address_space: Original ELF virtual addresses, NOT file offsets, save offsets or emulator host RAM addresses. Rebasing is not supported.

section_names.observation: All bytes zero; section indices/ranges survive, names do not.

reference_save.warning: European sample versus USA executable. Matching observed layout does not establish cross-region save acceptance. Save offsets below are NOT ELF VAs.

inventory.ownership_warning: Script-owned tests any nonzero byte; item usability also depends on definitions. Total unlock-array length is not established. Counter at280 is not asserted equal to nonzero record count; reference counter46 versus32 flagged records.

limitations: Exact USA executable only; EU sample has matching observed layout, not validated cross-region acceptance.
Secure-file transport and PFD integrity remain separate. No complete internal checksum or validation scheme has been established.
Weapon caps, XP thresholds and upgrade entries come from runtime definition data; node names, costs and prerequisites remain unknown.
Static field meaning is not sufficient to authorize editable UI controls; paired saves and load tests remain required.

weapon_configuration.filename_hash_normalization_observed: ASCII-uppercase UTF-8 full manifest paths, including leading slash

rules.ordinary: canBePurchased checks nonnegative/non-special cell and any orthogonal neighbor reported purchased; beenPurchased treats node 0 as purchased without mask bit 0.
rules.special: is_valid_movement and icon methods require every adjacent positive node to pass specialCheck; canBePurchased itself returns true for the special node. Ryno special marker is -3 (no positive special node).
rules.native_purchase: 0x2D2878 requires a hero, ownership and sufficient raritanium; enables bit through 0x465D00 and deducts cost through 0x24F748. This leaf does not enforce grid adjacency.

vendor_upgrade_layout.warning: Bytecode offsets are vendor built.dat FILE offsets, never ELF VAs. Literal grids and statically interpreted rules are not game-load validation; negative markers remain unspecified.

weapon_configuration.warning: These are shipped asset definitions and native bindings, not gameplay-validated edit bounds. CSV order is not a save-record ID map; inventory_catalog instead links native enum exports, constructors and named config getters. Vendor script grids and UI checks are mapped separately from native purchasing. Blank cells, negative grid markers, runtime overrides and cross-region acceptance remain unresolved. Twenty native ammo slots do not imply twenty playable weapon levels; the modifier array has 24 slots, not the mask's 32 bits.
